entry.name: designStyle
entry.label: Widget design: 0 for the latest design, 1 for the previous (v0.1.5) design

entry.name: compactViewStyle
entry.label: Compact panel view style: 0 for circles, 1 for bars

entry.name: refreshIntervalMinutes
entry.label: Usage refresh interval in minutes

entry.name: percentMode
entry.label: Show usage percentages as 0 for remaining, 1 for used

entry.name: badgeMode
entry.label: Expanded popup badge: 0 for the lowest remaining (or highest used) limit, 1 for the average of the shown limits, 2 for Claude's lowest remaining limit, 3 for Codex's lowest remaining limit, 4 to hide it

entry.name: clickAction
entry.label: Panel click action: 0 opens the popup, 1 opens the companion app

entry.name: compactShowTightestOnly
entry.label: Show only the lowest remaining (or highest used) limit in the panel

entry.name: compactShowLabels
entry.label: Show short limit labels under the panel meters

entry.name: warningThreshold
entry.label: Remaining percentage below which a limit shows the warning color

entry.name: criticalThreshold
entry.label: Remaining percentage below which a limit shows the critical color

entry.name: resetTimeFormat
entry.label: Reset time display: 0 for countdown and clock time, 1 for countdown only, 2 for clock time only

entry.name: clockFormat
entry.label: Clock format: 0 for the system default, 1 for 12-hour, 2 for 24-hour

entry.name: showCredits
entry.label: Show credit details in the expanded popup

entry.name: tooltipShowTightest
entry.label: Show the lowest remaining (or highest used) limit in the panel tooltip

entry.name: tooltipShowResetTime
entry.label: Show reset times in the panel tooltip

entry.name: tooltipShowLastUpdated
entry.label: Show the last update time in the panel tooltip

entry.name: showClaudeSession
entry.label: Show Claude current-session usage in the panel

entry.name: showClaudeWeekly
entry.label: Show Claude weekly usage in the panel

entry.name: showCodexFiveHour
entry.label: Show Codex five-hour usage in the panel

entry.name: showCodexWeekly
entry.label: Show Codex weekly usage in the panel

entry.name: showPacePointer
entry.label: Show the even-pace pointer on usage bars in the expanded popup
